{{Youmay|the director of the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military's]] [[Republic Intelligence/Legends|intelligence service]]|the [[Director of the Senate Bureau of Intelligence|Director]] of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Republic Senate's]] [[Senate Bureau of Intelligence/Legends|intelligence service]]}}
The '''Director of Republic Intelligence''' was the [[Director/Legends|director]] in charge of [[Republic Intelligence/Legends|Republic Intelligence]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], this office was held by [[Armand Isard/Legends|Armand Isard]] who also held the position of [[Director of the Senate Bureau of Intelligence]]. Along with the Republic's other intelligence services, Republic intelligence was reorganized into [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] with the reorganization of the Republic into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].
